name: Lunar system baseline
scope: Map volatiles, geology, heritage and science reserves.
deliverable: Global reference atlas and protected-zone treaty.

name: Upper-atmosphere model
scope: Couple GCM, thermosphere, exosphere, photochemistry, solar wind and Earth magnetotail.

name: Partial-gravity biology
scope: Run multi-generation organisms and long-duration human analogs at 0.16 g.

name: Regolith transformation
scope: Develop oxygen extraction, metal recovery, dust passivation and soil creation.
deliverable: Industrial process chain and ecological substrate.

name: Volatile acquisition
scope: Identify, move, capture and process nitrogen- and water-bearing bodies.

name: Closed ecological pilots
scope: Operate crater-scale sealed climates through full 29.5-day cycles.

name: Planetary power grid
scope: Deploy fission/fusion/solar/orbital generation with long-night storage.

name: Atmosphere build
scope: Raise pressure through controlled plateaus and verify each plateau.

name: Hydrosphere build
scope: Fill selected basins, establish groundwater and freeze-thaw buffers.

name: Biosphere succession
scope: Release microbes, lichens, soils, plants, fungi, invertebrates and later vertebrates.

name: Human settlement
scope: Build cities, artificial-gravity facilities, transport and public health systems.

name: Planetary operations
scope: Maintain atmosphere, climate, ecology, resources and emergency response.
